p: tenth year: That is, of the captivity of Jeconiah, or of the reign of Zedekiah. Of the order of these prophecies, and how the former sometimes stands after the latter. See Geneva "Jer 27:1"
dragon that lieth in the midst: He compares Pharaoh to a dragon which hides himself in the Nile river, as in Isa 51:9.
hooks in thy jaws: I will send enemies against you who will pluck you and your people which trust in you out of your sure places.
reed to the house of Israel: Read 2Ki 18:21, Isa 36:6.
shake: When you felt their hurt, they would stay no more on you, but stood on their feet and put their trust in others.
The river is mine: Thus God cannot permit man to attribute anything to himself or put his trust in anything save in him alone.

base kingdom: Meaning, that they would not have full dominion but be under the Persians, Greeks and Romans, and the reason is that the Israelites would no more put their trust in them, but learn to depend on God.
iniquity to remembrance: Lest I should by this means punish their sins.
seven and twentieth year: Counting from the captivity of Jeconiah.
service against Tyre: He took great pains at the siege of Tyre and his army was sore handled.
nor his army: Signifying that Nebuchadnezzar had more pains than profit by the taking of Tyre.
